exam.exam_name: Staff Selection Commission Junior Hindi Translator Examination (SSC JHT / SHT)
exam.application_cycle: Junior Hindi Translator, Junior Translation Officer and Senior Hindi Translator

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidates are required to capture live photograph through web-cam on a computer/laptop or through mobile app on a plain white or light-coloured background. Spectacles, caps and masks are not allowed while capturing live photograph.
source_evidence.document_title: Notice: Junior Hindi Translator, Junior Translation Officer and Senior Hindi Translator Examination, 2024
source_evidence.section_name: Annexure-III: Instructions for Live Photo Capture

requirements.content_instructions: Direct Live Digital Capture (Stored as JPEG); Captured directly via webcam or MySSC official mobile application; Digital direct capture; Plain white or light-coloured background strictly mandated; AI facial verification checks posture, lighting, and eye gaze before allowing submission on new ssc.gov.in portal

JPG / JPEG; Width 4.0 cm x Height 2.0 cm (approx 140 x 60 pixels); 4.0 cm x 2.0 cm; Pure white background; Signature in running handwriting with black ink on white paper; capital letters invalid; Strict size constraint: 10 KB to 20 KB enforced by SSC server

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
